ground_truth.definition: Per frame: take the PREVIOUS frame's six world probe points (a vertical stack above the screen-centre ground point) and re-project them through THIS frame's camera. The six displacements are the true image motion at six depths; their SPREAD is what a single global affine tx/ty has to absorb. Units are ANALYSIS pixels (1280x720), i.e. the same raster analyse_depth() resamples to.

scene_terms_deliberately_absent: shadow maps (re-rasterise per frame -> shimmer with no camera motion behind it)
what_this_is: A synthetic 3-D scene with depth, traversed by a follow-cam, rendered so galadriel's F7 operator (frame_forensics_depth.shake_features) can be given a NULL that has parallax in it. The existing null (synth_pan.mp4, np.roll of a flat image) has none.
